name: Embedded Systems
description: The course covers the fundamentals of embedded systems, including microcontrollers, ARM architectures, hardware–software co-design, and firmware development. Topics include system architecture (processors, memory, I/O, power), debugging tools, and interfacing with sensors, actuators, and communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi. Students also learn digital signal processing on embedded platforms, real-time operating systems (RTOS), and emerging trends in edge intelligence, IoT analytics, and security for edge devices.
